text: Accepted GlobalPopupNotifications still sets inline handlers for remaining popup controls, while the three constructor-function listener cases introduced in 1554 are gone. Its button action path separately checks focus and the security delay before invoking an action. Describe the specific port/reversal and shared widget responsibility, rather than teach that all notification handlers were moved inline-to-listener. Paired Gecko widget ownership is not independently established here. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: The popup port does not establish a universal ban on inline handlers
